## 1. What Does ManageMyWeb Do?
ManageMyWeb builds interactive 3D online stores for Shopify, WooCommerce, and custom e-commerce brands—and handles complete monthly website care. Instead of flat photo grids where shoppers leave in under 45 seconds, visitors step into a custom 3D showroom right inside Safari or Chrome on any phone or computer (zero app download needed) while still paying through the store owner's existing checkout.

For store owners tired of managing slow hosting, plugin crashes, broken DNS records, spammy email delivery, and slow freelancers, ManageMyWeb also runs all ongoing website tech and handles same-day edits over WhatsApp.

---

## 2. How the Free 48-Hour 3D Demo & Quote Process Works
1. **Share Your Website Link**: Store owners send their Shopify, WooCommerce, or custom website link along with 2 or 3 best-selling products.
2. **Free 3D Preview in 48 Hours**: ManageMyWeb builds a working 3D store demo featuring those exact products at zero cost.
3. **Clear Custom Quote**: After testing the live demo on their own phone, the owner receives a clear, itemized quote tailored to their store size—no surprise fees.

---

## 3. Platform Pages
- **Shopify 3D Store Integration** (`https://www.managemyweb.co/shopify-3d-store`): Live inventory, sizes, variants, Shop Pay, and Apple Pay stay synced inside Shopify.
- **WooCommerce 3D Store & Speed Care** (`https://www.managemyweb.co/woocommerce-3d-store`): Runs smoothly on cloud edge servers instead of bogged-down shared WordPress hosting while keeping WooCommerce checkout plugins working normally.
- **3D Online Store Examples** (`https://www.managemyweb.co/3d-store-examples`): Tailored layouts for clothing & sneakers, skincare & perfume, coffee & gourmet food, watches & jewelry, consumer electronics, and home furniture.

---

## 4. Plain-English FAQ
- **Do 3D websites rank on Google?** Yes. Every page includes full readable HTML text, fast ~1.1s mobile loads, XML sitemaps, and Schema.org structured data for Google Search and AI Overviews.
- **Do shoppers need an app or VR headset?** No. It runs directly in mobile Safari, Chrome, and desktop browsers at 60fps.
- **Can you manage a normal website without 3D?** Yes. Monthly Website Care covers hosting, domain/DNS management, email authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), speed optimization, daily backups, and same-day WhatsApp updates.
